author: Daniel Greene
description:
Yesterday, we broke down the news that Apple TV+ had secured Brandon Sanderson’s Cosmere — and why that alone was a big deal.

Today, the story gets significantly bigger.

Brandon Sanderson has now confirmed that he is actively involved in the script, and the level of creative control being described is almost unheard of in modern fantasy adaptations. This isn’t just an author consulting from the sidelines — this is Sanderson positioned as a creative architect for the Cosmere on screen.
title: Brandon Sanderson’s Apple TV+ Deal Just Got Better
